runs.content: Unilever (prices in GBX) beat Q3 on volume (USG 5.2%, volume 2.9%) and raised its FY26 volume guide to at least 3% as staples lead the rotation out of tech; the RDW remainder was trimmed for capacity at $7.83, a blended +26.12% and the largest closed win.

Polaris beat Q3 with real operating leverage (sales +11%, operational EPS $0.95 vs $0.41) and raised FY26 guidance for a third time, yet trades at ~17x the new EPS guide with a ~14% FCF yield (WISE trimmed −4.52% for capacity).
